description.zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID。
description.en:
The instance ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) Interface to query the details of all AnalyticDB PostgreSQL Instances in the target region, including Instance IDs.

description.zh:
数据库名称。

- 只能包含字母，数字和下划线。

- 必须以字母开头。

- 长度不能超过63 个字符。
description.en:
Database name.

*   Only contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_).
*   Must start with a letter.
*   Up to 63 characters in length.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb describe-extension --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --database-name test01 --extension-name zhparser --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb DescribeExtension --region cn-hangzhou --ExtensionName zhparser --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --DatabaseName test01
